terra.problem: The psalm does not say anyone was barred from arriving late or taking a seat in the back.
The explanation invents gift bags and what everyone in the assembly was thinking. The psalm gives neither detail.
The explanation says hearing cases is the problem. God’s complaint is that they judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked.
The psalm does not say the weak and fatherless have nobody to stand up for them.
The psalm says neither that the king and his officials have plenty of people in their corner nor that the weak and fatherless have nobody speaking up for them.
The psalm does not say the people named have no one to speak for them.
The verse says those addressed will fall like rulers. It does not say the rulers themselves are told they will fall.
